target_customer: Consumers ordering restaurant delivery, plus restaurants that want video-led discovery
problem: Delivery super apps show generic stock photos and inflated ratings, so people struggle to pick what to eat. BiteSight shows real dish videos from nearby restaurants and delivers the order.
business_model: delivery marketplace take rate and delivery fees
product_category: video-first food delivery and discovery app

founders.name: Lucious McDaniel IV
previous_startups: Treasury management company for nonprofits (outcome not stated)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built a $1M ARR product at 19 while moonlighting at a YC startup. Studied with Zac at UT Austin per YC page.

founders.name: Zac Schulwolf
education: UT Austin, Turing Scholar 2022 and master's in CS
founders.background_notes: Time-series transformer research per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: A consumer app with a video feed and order routing through existing delivery and restaurant integrations. Hard parts were restaurant onboarding and delivery logistics, not the software.

defensibility.rationale: Video feeds on top of delivery are easy for DoorDash or Uber Eats to copy. The only asset was a video library and early social buzz.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents were not reported to copy the feature during the company's life. The company was bought by Snoonu, a Qatari super app, in October 2026.

market_need_then: YC page frames incumbent apps as cluttered with stock images and inflated ratings. No dated spend or complaint data found.

identity.logo: Generic wordmark file, no distinctive mark found
identity.visual_style: Playful and casual, food emoji row, TikTok-style video poster
identity.voice_and_tone: Casual, uses the line TikTok meets DoorDash

branding.brand_signature: Founder TikTok posted in 2025 that briefly took the app to number 2 in App Store Food and Beverage
branding.community_and_virality: A viral founder TikTok in mid-2025 sent the app up the App Store charts above Uber Eats (TechCrunch, Black Enterprise).

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive viral launch moment, but the name and visual identity show no standout asset in sources. Reach came from founder content, not the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: BiteSight launched in early 2024 after YC Winter 2024, raised a reported 1.5 million dollar pre-seed, and found a burst of distribution in mid-2025 when a founder TikTok pushed the app to number 2 in the Food and Beverage chart. It stayed a small team and was acquired in October 2026 by Snoonu, which wanted video-led discovery for the Gulf. Terms were not disclosed, so whether this was a strong or soft outcome is unknown.
notes: Round amount and date come from aggregators (extruct, vcbacked, CB Insights) and disagree: CB Insights and PitchBook say 2 million total and one dates a round to June 2025. Treated 1.5M pre-seed as unverified against a primary source. Acquisition price undisclosed. No dated competitor sources near the 2024 batch were found; aggregator lists (Kitchenara, StoVoo, Beli) are undated.
